author: Ben
title: International arrivals fell in 2025 while domestic travel carries the market
detail: 68.3M international arrivals in 2025 vs 72.4M in 2024 (NTTO projects ~70.5M in 2026). Domestic travelers are $1.2T of $1.35T total U.S. travel spending.
whoAffected: Operators that depend on overseas visitors
implication: Demand mix is shifting. Whoever wins high-spending international niches, or domestic volume, gains.

sources.label: NTTO (U.S. Dept. of Commerce), Mar. 2026: 68.3 million international arrivals in 2025 vs. 72.4 million in 2024; NTTO projects about 70.5 million in 2026
U.S. Travel Association, 2025: $1.35 trillion total travel spending in 2025; domestic travelers account for $1.2 trillion (87%) across about 2.4 billion domestic trips
